wave.description: Compact curling turquoise ocean wave projectile moving RIGHT, cobalt water body, cyan rim, white sea foam crest curling forward, three small trailing droplets. No shark.
phases: Crest leaning forward, compact launch shape.
Crest curls farther forward and white foam breaks into a fresh pattern.
Crest reforms and droplets shift backward, seamless flight cycle.

bomb.description: Small stylized olive-green aerial bomb for crocodile bomber, rounded metal body, tail fins on LEFT, rounded nose pointing RIGHT, a tiny red-white-green painted band, metallic gold highlight, compact orange fuse spark behind. No aircraft, no crocodile.
phases: Bomb level, fuse spark a short orange star.
Same bomb tilted nose down slightly, fuse spark bright yellow.
Same bomb tilted nose down more, fuse spark a smaller red-orange flicker.

boom.description: Arcade bomb explosion effect only, rounded jagged white-yellow core, orange and coral fire lobes, a few charcoal smoke puffs, dark purple outline. No bomb, no character.
phases: Initial tight starburst ignition, mostly brilliant pale yellow with small orange rim.
Expanded fireball with broad orange lobes and white-yellow core.
Dissipating fireball with shrinking orange core and three thick charcoal-violet smoke puffs.

banana.description: Single bright yellow curved banana boomerang projectile, warm ochre underside, cream highlight and small brown stem, dynamic readable silhouette. No chimp or character.
phases: Banana crescent curving upward, stem on right.
Same banana rotated 120 degrees clockwise.
Same banana rotated 240 degrees clockwise.

clock.description: Small round golden magical pocket clock projectile, ivory dial, dark brown hour ticks, no numerals, cyan time-energy rim, two clearly readable hands, chunky brass casing. No elephant or character.
phases: Clock hands at 12 and 3, cyan rim sparks upper left.
Same clock, hands turned to 4 and 7, cyan rim sparks right.
Same clock, hands turned to 8 and 11, cyan rim sparks lower left.

ring.description: Horizontal elliptical cosmic Saturn ring projectile, golden and lavender concentric bands, dark-purple outline, small amber planet core, bright cream moving glint. No cow or limbs.
phases: Ring glint on left arc.
Same ring and proportions, glint at front-center arc.
Same ring and proportions, glint on right arc.

meteor.description: Compact craggy brown-violet meteor stone falling DOWN, warm golden rim on upper left, tapered orange-red flame tail extending UP, yellow inner flame and two hot sparks. No planet or character.
phases: Flame tail bends slightly left, front stone craters clear.
Same stone, flame tail straighter and longer, fresh sparks.
Same stone, flame tail bends slightly right, shorter flickering tip.

quake.description: Traveling ground shockwave effect moving RIGHT, jagged brown earthen rock spikes bursting from a short baseline, green moss fragments and ochre dirt chips, violet shadows, no continuous ground plane. No forest guardian.
phases: Small emerging stone spikes with a leading grass-topped shard.
Tall central stone spikes, leading shard thrusts forward, dirt chips rising.
Spikes crumble behind leading shard, chips falling, next small spike forming.
